description: This Java class 'SubjectDeletedStrategy' is a specialized strategy for handling SubjectDeleted events in a policy management context. It extends an abstract strategy class and implements the application of the SubjectDeleted event to modify policy builders.

classes.name: SubjectDeletedStrategy
classes.description: A final class that handles SubjectDeleted events by overriding the applyEvent method to modify a PolicyBuilder instance.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides the method to apply a SubjectDeleted event to a PolicyBuilder, removing the subject based on label and subject ID.
